_readme: Known failures of the responsive a11y sweep (e2e/suites/responsive-a11y.mjs): "<route> @ <width>" → rule ids failing there in either language. Rule ids are axe-core's, plus the sweep's own (see CUSTOM_RULES in e2e/lib/a11y-gate-lib.mjs). The sweep fails on anything not listed. Regenerate with `node e2e/suites/responsive-a11y.mjs --update`, which refuses to add entries. Each PR of docs/responsive-a11y-overhaul.md shrinks it; PR 7 empties it.
